# FAIE

Product key: faie
Canonical product: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/faie/index.html
Official MCP Registry: io.github.jgaethle10/faie
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/faie/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/faie/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- get an evidence-based agriculture or water risk brief
- research land production or resilience risk
- investigate an agriculture signal before making a decision
- build a sourced brief about farm water land or production risk

## Authority

public offer discovery and human-confirmed bounded research checkout

## Boundaries

- research is evidence support rather than consequential authority
- unknowns remain labeled
- checkout creation is not payment proof

## Native runtime

FAIE is implemented in the owned Forge/Systemia runtime with:
- human UI path: /faie/
- public-safe investigate API: /api/faie/investigate
- signal snapshot API: /api/faie/signals
- health API: /api/faie/health
- native read-only MCP path: /mcp/faie

The direct public hostname is not declared until Evercraft edge verification binds one. Public MCP investigations are ephemeral and are not written into the shared investigation archive.

## Universal Evercraft routing

Verified discovery fallback: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
